Extraction conventions (spec/tools/docx_asn1.py, clean-room, stdlib only): only '--'-comment markers count (prose naming ASN1STOP is not a marker); a STOP marker after code keeps the code; tagged /…/ example blocks are skipped; module headers may span lines (name, OID, DEFINITIONS); NBSP, smart quotes and dashes become ASCII; field codes, deletions and text boxes are not text. Output is byte-stable, and CI re-extracts to detect drift

Choice: rename only the C enumerator, to RRC_CA_BandwidthClassNR_r17_value_t, after generation. The ASN.1 and the value name JER and printing use stay 't', and PER is index-based so unaffected. It is the only enumerator/typedef clash in the five protocols

Then all 8110 generated headers of the five protocols compile together in one C++20 translation unit (-Wall -Wextra), so the plan's one-protocol-per-translation-unit rule is unnecessary and dropped
